title: Ring Alert Volume by Type Trend
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ring:neighbor alert_type=* distance_m=*
| timechart span=1w count as alerts, avg(distance_m) as avg_distance by alert_type
| fillnull value=0
description: Trends weekly Ring Neighbors alert counts and average distance by alert type.
value: Alert-type trends reveal whether package thefts, strangers, or animals dominate your block's noise.
implementation: Export Ring Neighbors alerts with `alert_type` and `distance_m` and review weekly type mix.
visualization: Multi-series line chart of alerts by type.
grandmaExplanation: It watches what kinds of Ring Neighbors alerts happen most around your home each week.
